# NXTPoint Logistics Leaders 

 

### Mike Liantonio 

President

Mike brings more than 30 years of leadership experience across logistics, supply chain and distribution. Known in the industry for driving operational excellence and transformational growth, he is leading NXTPoint Logistics into its next phase of innovation and expansion.

Prior to NXTPoint, Mike served as CEO of Wrist Ship Supply, the world’s largest global marine supply company, where he oversaw operations across North and Central America. Under his leadership, Wrist achieved significant organic and strategic growth, including an exponential increase in earnings driven by Mike’s mentorship and development of high-performing teams. His career also includes senior leadership roles at FedEx Supply Chain Solutions, Yusen Logistics, Momentum Transportation, CSX and i2 Technologies.

A graduate of the U.S. Military Academy at West Point, Mike served nearly a decade in the U.S. Army, during which time he served as Company Commander in Bosnia. Mike’s passion for transportation and logistics was forged in the military and followed him into the private sector upon his transition from active duty.

### Matt VanderLinde 

Chief Operating Officer, Supply Chain Solutions

Matt brings a wealth of experience and a proven track record in the logistics and supply chain industry. Prior to joining NXTPoint, Matt worked for Atlas World Group where he performed several roles during his tenure, including the launch of Atlas Logistics in 2012 and was instrumental in driving its strategic direction and growth.

Matt’s expertise in supply chain solutions and freight brokerage greatly enhances NXTPoint’s ability to deliver on our key strategic priorities, including enhancing our transportation and brokerage capabilities, and expanding service offerings to meet the evolving needs of our current and future customers.

### Michelle Bailey 

Chief Operating Officer, Final Mile Home Delivery

With nearly 20 years of experience in the home delivery industry, including time with NonStop Delivery, Estes Forwarding Worldwide and Need It Now Delivers, Michelle brings a wealth of experience and expertise to NXTPoint Logistics. She has spearheaded numerous initiatives to transform home delivery operations, resulting in increased efficiency, customer satisfaction, and significant business expansion. Her expertise in optimizing supply chain processes, implementing innovative technologies, and fostering a customer-centric approach are invaluable as NXTPoint expands and enhances home delivery services.

As COO, Michelle oversees all aspects of the home delivery business, including capacity planning, fleet management, customer experience, and operational efficiency. Her main goal is to ensure that NXTPoint provides exceptional customer service and positions the business to scale with growth objectives.

### Mark Frazier 

Chief Client Officer 

Mark is accountable for developing and implementing a comprehensive business development and account management strategy across all of NXTPoint’s service offerings. With his deep industry knowledge and exceptional business acumen, Mark has excelled in this role and brings significant value to the organization.

Throughout his 10+ year tenure with the organization, Mark has proven himself to be an exceptional leader, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and excellence within his team. His ability to identify opportunities, forge strategic alliances, and deliver results has been instrumental in positioning NXTPoint as a leader in the 3PL space.

### Lee Kirk 

Chief Operating Officer, Contract Logistics

Lee oversees daily operations, develops strategies to improve efficiency, strengthens client relationships and leads our talented workforce at NXTPoint Logistics. With over two decades of experience in third-party logistics and supply chain management, Lee has held key leadership positions at firms like CEVA, GXO, ODW, Radial and GEODIS. His dual experience in 3PL and client-side operations equips him to implement warehouse automation and other enhancements to improve customer experience, optimize performance and reduce costs.

Lee holds a B.B.A. from Stephen F. Austin State University along with 20+ years of experience in logistics and supply chain management. He has a proven track record in operational leadership and is committed to adhering to industry regulations while leveraging innovative technologies to enhance logistics solutions.

### Karla Cervantes 

Senior Vice President, Accounting & Finance

Karla is responsible for leading the accounting division across the NXTPoint enterprise. With 25+ years of experience, Karla is a trusted leader who has held multiple roles throughout the company since joining in 2000, including Staff Accountant, Controller, and Director of Accounting across the household goods and logistics service offerings.

Karla oversees the financial, analysis, billing, and disbursements teams. Her focus is to ensure financial accuracy and adherence to policies and guidelines while driving efficiencies to better focus on the strategic financial goals of the enterprise. Karla looks to innovate while continually being agile and cares about the organization, customers, and clients.

### Trish St. John 

Senior Vice President, EHS & Quality Assurance

Trish is a Compliance leader with two decades of experience managing risk, regulatory affairs, and quality assurance. Her ability to implement robust safety and quality management systems while improving business performance has led to the successful growth of the EHS and Quality Assurance (EHSQ) programs. In her tenure, Trish has successfully led the oversight for all internal audit schemes and attained several key certifications for the business including ISO9001:2015 and the Global Food Safety Initiative.

Trish is certified as a DOT Hazardous Materials Instructor, OSHA 501 & 511 for General Industry, ISO9001 Lead Auditor and Governance Risk & Compliance (GRC) Auditor. She is extensively trained in emergency management, vulnerability threat assessments, risk analytics for natural disasters and risk intelligence collection.

Trish has a B.A. from the University of North Florida in Political Science & Public Administration and was awarded the Regional Director’s Conservation Award from U.S. Fish & Wildlife Service for Outstanding Contributions to Conservation in the Southeast Region.

### Randy Bruce 

Marketing Director

Randy is a seasoned marketing leader with over a decade of experience in the logistics industry. With a strategic mindset and a passion for delivering exceptional customer experiences, Randy drives integrated marketing initiatives that fuel brand growth and revenue performance.

Over his 13-year tenure at NXTPoint, Randy has played a pivotal role in shaping the company’s brand identity and market presence. He leads cross-functional efforts across branding, communications, public relations, content strategy, and campaign development—ensuring that every touchpoint reflects the company’s commitment to innovation and a customer-first mindset.

Randy’s approach is informed by a diverse professional background, including impactful roles at globally recognized brands such as Red Bull and Billabong. His creative edge and global perspective are complemented by a strong academic foundation—he holds a B.A. in Comparative Literature from Hamilton College.

Known for his collaborative leadership style and results-driven mindset, Randy continues to elevate NXTPoint’s marketing function as a strategic growth engine within the organization.

# NXTPoint Logistics Names Tyler Page Vice President of Operations 

Jacksonville, Fla. (July 23, 2026) – NXTPoint Logistics is pleased to announce the addition of Tyler Page as Vice President of Operations. In this role, Tyler will lead operational functions across the organization’s contract logistics service line, leveraging his extensive global supply chain experience to further enhance service delivery, efficiency and customer satisfaction.

Tyler brings 22 years of supply chain leadership experience, having operated in nearly every aspect of the industry, including warehousing, international freight forwarding and the oversight of facilities spanning six continents. His experience has provided him with a deep understanding of complex, global logistics networks and the ability to drive scalable, customer-focused operational solutions.

In his most recent roles at DSV and Sunland Logistics Solutions, Tyler focused on advancing operational performance through continuous process improvement, organizational alignment and cross-functional leadership. He has consistently driven results in high-volume, global environments by optimizing workflows, strengthening team execution and enhancing customer-facing outcomes. Tyler is also a Lean Six Sigma Black Belt, bringing a disciplined, data-driven approach to continuous improvement and operational excellence.

“I’m excited to join NXTPoint Logistics and be part of a team that truly values its people,” Tyler says. “The culture at NXTPoint really stood out to me in every conversation that led to this role, and I’m looking forward to growing our client relationships and helping drive the continued growth of the company.”

Throughout his career, Tyler has built a reputation for leading with a focus on people and performance. His leadership philosophy is grounded in three core strengths: a commitment to caring for his teams, a belief that taking care of employees enables them to take care of the customer and a strong passion for excellence in the supply chain industry.

“Tyler’s global experience and people-first approach make him a tremendous addition to our leadership team,” says Lee Kirk, COO of Contract Logistics at NXTPoint. “His ability to lead complex operations while fostering strong teams aligns perfectly with our culture and our vision for continued growth. We’re thrilled to welcome him to the team.”

# NXTPoint Logistics Welcomes Matt VanderLinde as New Chief Operating Officer, Supply Chain Solutions 

Jacksonville, Fla. – As NXTPoint continues to accelerate the growth of NXTPoint Logistics, we are pleased to announce that Matt VanderLinde has joined the leadership team as Chief Operating Officer for the Supply Chain Solutions team. Matt brings a wealth of experience and a proven track record in the managed logistics and supply chain industry.

Most recently, Matt worked for Atlas Logistics, where he performed several roles during his 12+ year tenure and was instrumental in driving its strategic direction and growth. Matt was responsible for strategic planning, business development, and acquisition integration activities for Atlas Logistics. Additionally, he oversaw sales, pricing, service line expansion, and operational oversight over 3PL services. Prior to Atlas, Matt worked for Suddath, parent company of NXTPoint Logistics, from 2002-2012 in various sales and operational leadership roles.

“I am very excited that Matt is rejoining the organization,” says Mike Brannigan, President & CEO. “He brings an accomplished track record of success and his expertise in both managed logistics and freight brokerage greatly enhances NXTPoint’s ability to deliver on our key strategic priorities, including enhancing our transportation and brokerage capabilities, and expanding service offerings to meet the evolving needs of our current and future customers.”

# NXTPoint Logistics Welcomes Lee Kirk as New Chief Operating Officer, Contract & Managed Logistics 

JACKSONVILLE, Fla. – NXTPoint Logistics, a leading provider of logistics and transportation services, is pleased to announce the appointment of Lee Kirk as the new Chief Operating Officer for Contract and Managed Logistics. Kirk brings over two decades of experience in third-party logistics and supply chain management with a proven track record in operational leadership.

Kirk has held key positions at prominent firms such as CEVA, XPO, Geodis/OHL, ODW Logistics and Radial, where he successfully managed complex warehouse and distribution operations for global clients. His most recent role as VP of Supply Chain, Manufacturing and Warehouse Operations at The Indoor Golf Shop has provided him with valuable insights from the client perspective.

Kirk’s dual experience in both 3PL and client-side operations has equipped him to implement warehouse automation and other enhancements that focus on improving customer experience, optimizing performance and reducing costs—all crucial areas for NXTPoint Logistics’ growth in the coming years.

In expressing his excitement to join NXTPoint, Kirk shares, “The organization is well-positioned to continue its exponential growth. With a world-class team, genuine client partnerships, and the drive for best-in-class innovation, the future holds countless exciting possibilities.”

“We are excited to have Lee on board and look forward to the valuable contributions he will make in driving our business forward,” said Michael Brannigan, CEO and President of The Suddath Companies.

In his new role, Kirk will oversee daily operations, develop and implement strategies to improve efficiency, strengthen client relationships, lead the division’s talented workforce, ensure adherence to industry regulations, and leverage innovative technologies to enhance logistics capabilities. His addition reinforces NXTPoint’s commitment to superior service through knowledgeable industry experts.

# NXTPoint Logistics Announces Addition of Chris Tierney, Vice President of Operations – JJV 

Jacksonville, Fla. (June 30, 2026) – NXTPoint Logistics is pleased to announce the appointment of Chris Tierney as Vice President of Operations, where he will oversee all aspects of the organization’s Johnson & Johnson Vision partnership. With a strong commitment to safety, continuous improvement, and effective leadership, Chris brings extensive experience from some of the world’s most recognized organizations.

Throughout his career, Chris has successfully led large-scale workforce transitions, managed multi-billion-dollar logistics operations, and driven complex operational turnarounds. He is widely recognized for fostering safety-first cultures, mentoring emerging leaders, and delivering sustainable cost savings, strong financial performance, and innovative process improvements that enhance both operational outcomes and employee engagement.

Chris began his career as an Industrial Engineer at Sanford Corporation before joining Ford Motor Company in 1995. Over the course of 26 years at Ford, he progressed through a wide range of roles across maintenance, engineering, quality, procurement, product development, and new model launches. He ultimately served as a site leader overseeing final assembly operations at one of the company’s highest-volume production facilities globally. During his tenure, Chris contributed to numerous operational achievements and efficiency initiatives, including driving $176 million in cost reductions during the 2008 financial crisis.

Most recently, Chris served for five years as a General Manager at Amazon, where he led operations at a 2.9 million square-foot facility in Jacksonville, Florida. In this role, he was responsible for operational performance, cultural transformation, and overall site leadership. Leveraging his expertise in Six Sigma and Lean methodologies, Chris implemented significant improvements in safety, employee experience, quality, cost management, and customer satisfaction, resulting in enhanced productivity and on-time delivery performance.

Chris is deeply committed to servant leadership and people development. As he notes, “My vision has always been to be the best employer — engaging our people, understanding what matters most to them, and leveraging their ideas to drive continuous improvement. When leaders are focused on helping employees succeed, strong results naturally follow.”

In his new role at NXTPoint Logistics, Chris is focused on building a culture of continuous improvement grounded in safety, innovation, resilience, and empowerment. He is dedicated to inspiring teams to challenge boundaries, embrace change, and deliver sustainable, scalable growth.

“Chris’ proven track record in leading large-scale operations, developing high-performing teams, and driving meaningful continuous improvement makes him an exceptional addition to our leadership team,” said Mike Liantonio, President of NXTPoint Logistics. “His commitment to safety, innovation, and people-first leadership aligns closely with our core values, and we are confident he will have an immediate and lasting impact.”

Chris holds a Master of Science in Manufacturing and Operations Management from Kettering University and a Bachelor of Science in Industrial Management and Engineering from Purdue University. He is also Six Sigma Black Belt certified.
